Resolves #19217

Two unit specs that stub the main thread's `document` and `window` at module level — `main/DomEvents.spec.mjs` and `main/draggable/sensor/Touch.spec.mjs` — lost those stubs mid-file whenever a neighbour in the same worker restored the undefined it had captured at its own import, which is what turned `unit` red on attempt 1 of neo #19198's run and on both attempts of PR #19214's. They now re-install their own references in `beforeEach` (the same objects the module-level install created, so the singletons' import-time listeners stay valid) and run serial within the file, and each carries a test that deletes both globals ahead of the next one: the exact act of the neighbour's teardown, now harmless. No production code changes.

Evidence: L1 (unit, red first on the deterministic reproduction) → L1 required (AC-1); AC-2 is CI's own green at this head. Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — two hooks, two serial declarations, two guard tests; no source file touched.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the CI baseline jobs ran.

| AC-2 | CI at this head, and PR #19214's rerun once `dev` carries this. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. `test.describe.configure({mode: 'serial'})` is added to both files because their module-level stubs are per-worker state, so the guard test's deletion has to precede the next test in the same worker; that also matches how the files already behaved.
